title: Attention habits
description: Prompts for protecting focus and turning study into a durable habit.

cards.front: What is the scarce resource when answers are free?
cards.back: Your attention — and what you choose to encode into long-term memory.

cards.front: Name one way AI helps flashcard study without replacing practice.
cards.back: Drafting candidate cards you still edit, or clarifying a concept so you write a cleaner prompt.

cards.front: Why finish a session before you are exhausted?
cards.back: Stopping with a little energy left makes starting tomorrow easier.

cards.front: What breaks encoding even if you “study” for an hour?
cards.back: Constant context switches — notifications, tabs, and feeds that never let an idea settle.
